findings.summary: Architecture-adversary MIXED(1): P made comparable_blocks population-aware, but its caller _floor_from passed no population, so a holdout entry's INCONCLUSIVE(below-noise-floor) threshold was computed from the baseline/dev population and applied to a holdout delta — the cross-population-number-as-effect P exists to kill, and internally inconsistent (P filters the PAIR to baseline yet applied that floor to non-baseline entries).
findings.disposition: cmd_score now computes a per-population floor (cached per form) and threads each entry's population through _floor_from -> comparable_blocks; the report diagnostic stays baseline-default (a dev-population read). Verified against the tree before accepting. Pinned by test_harness (a holdout want with one holdout block reads UNMEASURED, not a dev floor) — the fix's test is in the calibration fixed stage, not suite_glob, so recorded incorporated per the known RS-P2 closure-evidence constraint.

findings.summary: Architecture-adversary lead: fixture_legibility_problems scanned only .py/.sh/.md while stage() copies every fixture file except __pycache__/*.pyc — a tell in a .txt/.toml/.cfg fixture would be staged to the doer yet unscanned (sweep surface != staging surface).
findings.disposition: The sweep now scans the SAME surface stage() copies (every file except .pyc, __pycache__ pruned), errors='replace' so a stray binary is harmless. Incorporated in 1b980ace.

findings.summary: Architecture-adversary lead: _is_fixture gained a second cross-module consumer (build_completion_reminder) while keeping its underscore-private name.
findings.disposition: Promoted to public is_fixture_data; both consumers updated. The _seg_writes import from test_lock_guard deliberately stays underscore (renaming a symbol inside a BLOCKING guard for cosmetics is riskier than tolerating it — the reviewer's own counsel).

findings.summary: Architecture-adversary lead: reset_plan.py:163 re-types the four lock-state filenames as literals instead of importing host_contract's constants — the one place the 'lock state files' set is still hand-typed after U1 gave it an owner.

Self-caught (U2): the dated form-correction note was PREPENDED to history.md, violating the append-only byte-prefix invariant; check_scoreboard_integrity REDed it immediately. Re-appended at the file end; parser tolerance verified (275 rows still parse).
findings.disposition: Correction appended at the end with a note it applies to all blocks above; the integrity check is what caught the wrong placement. Self-caught by a mechanical oracle.

findings.summary: Self-caught (A.3): a regression assertion was inserted into the MIDDLE of a with-block, orphaning the block tail (IndentationError). Moved to the function end.
findings.disposition: Caught by running the suite (parse error) before commit; re-placed at function-body indent after the with-block.

findings.summary: Self-caught (U3a): de-legibilizing verify_install.sh changed its FAIL echo line, which is the edit-anchor for the script-unsafe-probe scenario — --dry-run flagged 'edits do not apply'. Restored the anchor ('control' there is a legitimate security access-control phrase, not a calibration tell).
findings.disposition: Anchor restored; --dry-run confirms all 48 scenarios apply. The real tells (header comments naming the harness) were removed and stay removed.

findings.summary: Self-caught (A.1 smoke test): fixture_guard's first list-diff was positional, so PREPENDING a case read as 'every element changed' and false-warned — the exact warning-fatigue failure David scoped the guard to avoid.
findings.disposition: Switched to multiset matching (an old element is preserved if some new element differs only in non-answer ways); pinned by test_fixture_guard (prepend/append/reorder silent; delete/answer-change warn).
